sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Repair the semantic constraints before freezing. Constrain bladeFailureLoadApplicationRadiusRatio on its QuantityValue numericValue to exactly 0.8 using equal inclusive bounds (sh:minInclusive and sh:maxInclusive), while retaining its dimensionless unit; the current shape permits any ratio and therefore does not encode application at 0.8R. Require nltl:bladeFailureStatus on the ship with xsd:boolean and minCount 1/maxCount 1, so absence cannot pass; retain the SPARQL biconditional for failure exactly when bladeTipOffset exceeds 0.10*propellerDiameter.
